CVH-007-TACTILE.title: Complete full tactile UX and backend architecture for CanbanVoimaxHarness

CVH-007-TACTILE.summary: Delivered full tactile UX and hardened backend architecture for CanbanVoimaxHarness. Integrated global ToolPolicyModal, topbar settings button, live token savings telemetry badge, unified visual Diff Viewer in ToolExecutionCard for edit_file/str_replace with Split/JSON tabs, ContextGauge in AgentConsoleDrawer with instant log evaporation and quick prompt bar. Implemented Rust State-Preserving Context Compactor, Tool Policy Matrix zero-trust check, output spilling for oversized stdout/stderr, built-in web_search and web_fetch tools, and Anthropic deterministic prefix caching. Resolved Level 2 review caveats regarding redundant JSX closing tags in Topbar, HeaderName type bounds, and compactor borrow moves.
